name: Gray's Body Shop
addr: 21 Grey Rock Valley RD, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: I strongly recommend Gray 's Body Shop . They are very professional, friendy, and the repair work they have done to my 4 cars over the past 8 years has always been 1st class at a very reasonably priced.
Gray's replaced bumper in record time. They are professional & friendly.
Mr Whitey Gray is a true professional, he and the folks at Gray's Body Shop do beautiful work. My truck is back to new looking with its completely repaired fender and paint.

Great place to get your car fixed right up. They do exquisite work without being terribly expensive. They are honest and give a quick and accurate estimate on the cost. Loved working with them and would recommend them to anyone.
Very professional and honest. My vehicle looks like new again.
Excellent quality work. Kept me informed all the way as they disassembled and rebuilt our car.
The service was excellent they did what they said they would do at the time they said they would do it.Im very satisfied with their work I would give them a 5 star rating
Best experience. Quick and perfect match paint job. Would use again!
Excellent service, easy to work, with honest, and customer oriented
Always get great service at Gray's!
